description: Purchase of Utility Vehicles for Government developments activities and filed operations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- It has been identified that the existing shortage of utility vehicles in the relevant institutions has become serious obstacle for efficient and effective implementation of Government Development Projects. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to initiate the procurement process to expeditiously purchase the following utility vehicles, was approved by the Cabinet.
